acceptance_criteria_patterns.description: Given-When-Then patterns for common requirement types, based on Agile best practices from Atlassian, AltexSoft, and EasyAgile.

data_handling.then: the [input data] is stored/transformed according to [business rule]

data_handling.when: a user requests to view/export the [data type]
data_handling.then: the system displays/exports the [data type] in [expected format]

user_interaction.then: the system responds with [expected behavior] within [timeframe if applicable]
the system [allows/prevents] the action and [shows confirmation/error]

integration.then: the [data] is correctly transmitted and [acknowledgment/response] is received

integration.when: the system attempts to communicate with [external system]
integration.then: the system handles the failure gracefully with [fallback behavior]

reporting.given: [data set] has been collected over [time period]
reporting.then: the report includes [expected metrics/fields] and is available in [format]

access_control.then: the system [grants/denies] access based on [permission rules]

workflow.then: the [process/task] transitions to [new state] and [side effects]

functional_requirement_patterns.description: System must patterns for common requirement categories.

patterns.data_validation: The system must validate [input] against [rules] before [processing step].
patterns.data_persistence: The system must persist [data type] in [storage] with [retention policy].
patterns.performance: The system must complete [operation] within [time limit] under [load conditions].
patterns.error_handling: The system must handle [error condition] by [recovery action] and [notification].
patterns.audit_trail: The system must log [action/event] with [details] for [audit purpose].
patterns.data_integrity: The system must ensure [data] remains consistent when [concurrent operation] occurs.
patterns.accessibility: The system must provide [feature] that is accessible to [user group].
patterns.compliance: The system must comply with [standard/regulation] when [handling data/performing action].

invest_checklist.description: INVEST quality checklist for user story validation.

criteria.independent: The story can be developed and delivered independently of other stories.
criteria.negotiable: The story captures intent and leaves room for discussion on implementation.
criteria.valuable: The story delivers clear, identifiable value to users or stakeholders.
criteria.estimable: The story is specific enough for the team to estimate effort.
criteria.small: The story is small enough to be completed within a single iteration.
criteria.testable: The story has clear acceptance criteria that can be verified.

smart_checklist.description: SMART framework for acceptance criteria quality.

criteria.specific: The criterion describes a single, well-defined scenario.
criteria.measurable: The expected outcome can be objectively verified.
criteria.achievable: The criterion is technically and practically feasible.
criteria.relevant: The criterion directly supports the user story's intent.
criteria.time_bound: The criterion includes timing expectations where applicable.
